chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0611: Ji Ning's Attrition Siege Against True Immortal Dongjun
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the brutal economics of the World Prison—starve a True Immortal of energy or force submission. A masterclass in Xianxia siege warfare.
og_title: The Prison Siege Begins: Ji Ning vs. True Immortal Dongjun
og_description: Inside the World Prison, raw power means nothing. The only thing that matters is who runs out of fuel first.
twitter_title: Ji Ning slowly cooks a True Immortal. Yes, it's as metal as it sounds.
twitter_description: Attrition warfare in the World Prison: Ji Ning deploys the Eight-Fires Cosmos to slowly roast a Daofather-level prisoner who called him a worm.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator who has achieved the Pure Yang stage, embodying immortality and mastery over a complete Grand Dao.
A high-level sword formation technique that condenses multiple flying swords into a single, powerful attack.
A treasure containing eight types of true fire, useful for sustained area-denial and attrition tactics.
A prideful True Immortal of the Nine Sacred Chaos Realm, imprisoned for an unnamed crime, possessing Daofather-level power.
A precious fluid distilled from the chaos, used as a key catalyst for soul-splitting clone techniques.
